methods.label: Check both implications
methods.explanation: \(x>2\) requires \(x>0\), so it is necessary. Knowing only that \(x>0\) does not imply \(x>2\), so it is not sufficient.
methods.levelReason: Uses the definitions of necessary and sufficient conditions with elementary real-number comparisons.
